title: Khalid Jamil Names 23-Man India Squad For New Zealand Friendlies
excerpt: Hrithik Tiwari, Som Kumar and Vishal Kaith are the goalkeepers for the November 12 match in Auckland and November 15 match in Christchurch, with Gurpreet Singh Sandhu left out and three players pulled from the SAFF Championship squad.
body:
• India men's head coach Khalid Jamil named a 23-player squad on Friday, November 6, for two friendlies against New Zealand in the November FIFA International Match Window.
  • India play New Zealand on Thursday, November 12, at the Go Media Stadium in Auckland at 11:30 a.m. IST, and on Sunday, November 15, at the One New Zealand Stadium in Christchurch at 8:30 a.m. IST.
  • Hrithik Tiwari, Som Kumar and Vishal Kaith are the three goalkeepers named, with veteran Gurpreet Singh Sandhu left out of the squad.
  • Bijoy Varghese, Muhammad Suhail and Liston Colaco will leave Naushad Moosa's SAFF Championship 2026 squad in Dhaka to join the New Zealand tour instead.

Indian men's national team head coach Khalid Jamil named his 23-player squad on Friday, November 6, for two friendlies against New Zealand during the November FIFA International Match Window, Khel Now reported. The squad assembles in Bengaluru on Saturday, November 7, trains on Sunday and departs for Auckland later that night.

The fixtures

India face New Zealand first on Thursday, November 12, at the Go Media Stadium in Auckland at 11:30 IST, and again on Sunday, November 15, at the One New Zealand Stadium in Christchurch at 08:30 IST. The All India Football Federation (AIFF) has said the tour will be the Indian men's team's first-ever visit to New Zealand and its first trip to an OFC member nation since 2005, when India played two friendlies against Fiji. The AIFF also noted that New Zealand took part in the FIFA World Cup 2026, where they drew with IR Iran and lost to Egypt and Belgium.

"New Zealand are also a World Cup-playing nation and a strong opponent, and these two matches will be a good test for us away from home. We want to prepare well, play with discipline and use this opportunity to improve as a team."

— Khalid Jamil, India head coach

Goalkeeping change and absences

The goalkeepers named are Hrithik Tiwari, Som Kumar and Vishal Kaith. Gurpreet Singh Sandhu is not in the 23, a change also reported by Sports Now, which said defender Anwar Ali has been ruled out with a Grade 1 hamstring injury and is expected to be sidelined for over a month. The AIFF squad announcement itself, as reproduced by Khel Now and ArunFoot, does not list Sandhu or Ali among the 23.

Three players switch from the SAFF Championship

Three of the 23 — Bijoy Varghese, Muhammad Suhail and Liston Colaco — were also named in Naushad Moosa's SAFF Championship 2026 squad. They will not continue in that tournament in Dhaka and will instead link up with Jamil's squad for New Zealand. Farukh Choudhary, Noufal PN and Hmingthanmawia Ralte have been released from the SAFF Championship squad and will return to their club, Mumbai City FC, while Ronney Kharbudon will not travel to Dhaka because of an injury, Khel Now reported.

The 23-player squad

Goalkeepers: Hrithik Tiwari, Som Kumar, Vishal Kaith.

Defenders: Abhishek Singh Tekcham, Akash Mishra, Bijoy Varghese, Jay Gupta, Mehtab Singh, Pramveer, Ricky Meetei Haobam, Roshan Singh Naorem.

Midfielders: Anirudh Thapa, Ashique Kuruniyan, Jithin MS, Lalremtluanga Fanai, Lalrinliana Hnamte, Tomba Singh Haobam.

Forwards: David Lalhlansanga, Edmund Lalrindika, Liston Colaco, Manvir Singh, Muhammad Suhail, Ryan Williams.

For Indian supporters in New Zealand, the two matches are the national team's first fixtures in the country, in Auckland on November 12 and Christchurch on November 15. For Jamil, the stated test is away from home against a World Cup-playing opponent, with the Bengaluru assembly and a single training session on Sunday the only preparation time the announcement sets out before departure.
